description: GitHub Mobile now supports iPhone Duo, with a layout that adapts when unfolded and vertical tabs to help you move between key areas like Copilot, Pull Requests, Issues, and Notifications.… The post Take GitHub Mobile with you on iPhone Duo appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: GitHub Mobile now supports iPhone Duo, with a layout that adapts when unfolded and vertical tabs to help you move between key areas like Copilot, Pull Requests, Issues, and Notifications. Whether you’re catching up on activity or working with your repositories, you can navigate GitHub on the go.
